name: abl3
notes: Targeted data for the largest error class (instruction following: copying a neighbouring function's body). Each change runs with both baseline seeds and is compared seed by seed. base_s1 and base_s2 are the abl2 baseline runs (identical configuration and code; default data verified byte-identical after the NOVEL_DRAWS change).

arms.name: novel_x5_s1
arms.changes: five times as many fresh-constant exercises (30 constants instead of 6, all 8 ordinals): the model must read the number or ordinal instead of recalling a memorised body

arms.name: contrast_x3_s1
arms.changes: three contrast bug fixes per exercise instead of one (the buggy body is a one-word neighbour's correct code)
